types.name: Coins, dice and cards
types.description: Asks the chance of an outcome when coins are tossed, dice thrown or a single card drawn.

types.name: Drawing with combinations
types.description: Draws two or more balls, cards or people at once and asks the chance of a particular mix.

types.name: Addition rule and complements
types.description: Gives P(A), P(B) and P(A∩B) or uses "or", "either", "neither" and asks for a union or complement.

types.name: Conditional probability and independence
types.description: Uses "given that", "independent", "both" or "without replacement" and asks for a joint or conditional probability.

types.name: Total probability and Bayes' theorem
types.description: Several sources (machines, urns, factories) with shares and rates, and asks which source an observed result came from.

types.name: Definitions, axioms and odds
types.description: Asks about definitions, axioms, mutually exclusive or exhaustive events, or converts odds to probability.
